    schema_query = 'PRAGMA table_info("clinical_manifestations");'
    schema_df = pd.read_sql_query(schema_query, conn)
    print("Columns in clinical_manifestations table:")
    print(schema_df[['name', 'type']])
    
    # Check if age band column exists
    age_band_columns = [col for col in schema_df['name'] if 'age' in col.lower() or 'band' in col.lower()]
    
    if not age_band_columns:
        print("\nNo age band column found. Available columns:")
        print(schema_df['name'].tolist())
        age_band_column = input("Please enter the exact column name for age band: ")
    else:

        cm."{age_band_column}" AS age_band,

    FROM basic_medical_record_informatio bmri
    JOIN clinical_manifestations cm ON bmri."Case ID" = cm."Case ID"
    WHERE cm."{age_band_column}" IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY cm."{age_band_column}"
    HAVING COUNT(*) >= 10
    ORDER BY record_count DESC

import sqlite3

SELECT 
    -- Aggregate by Occupation Type instead of individual records
    bmri."Occupation Type (Childcare/Student/Teacher)" AS occupation_group,
    COUNT(*) AS record_count,
    ROUND(AVG(cm."Highest Body Temperature (°C)"), 2) AS avg_temperature,
    MAX(cm."Highest Body Temperature (°C)") AS max_temperature,
    MIN(cm."Highest Body Temperature (°C)") AS min_temperature
FROM basic_medical_record_informatio bmri
JOIN clinical_manifestations cm ON bmri."Case ID" = cm."Case ID"
WHERE cm."Highest Body Temperature (°C)" IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY bmri."Occupation Type (Childcare/Student/Teacher)"
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 10
ORDER BY max_temperature DESC
'''

print("Aggregated analysis of Highest Body Temperature by Occupation Group:")
print("(Individual records cannot be shown per deployment policy)")
print("=" * 80)

result_df = pd.read_sql_query(query, conn)

if not result_df.empty:
    for _, row in result_df.iterrows():
        print(f"\nOccupation Group: {row['occupation_group']}")
        print(f"  Record Count: {row['record_count']}")
        print(f"  Average Temperature: {row['avg_temperature']}°C")
        print(f"  Maximum Temperature: {row['max_temperature']}°C")
        print(f"  Minimum Temperature: {row['min_temperature']}°C")
else:
    print("No results found with sufficient records.")

temp_query = '''
SELECT 
    CASE 
        WHEN "Highest Body Temperature (°C)" < 37.5 THEN 'Normal (<37.5°C)'
        WHEN "Highest Body Temperature (°C)" < 38.5 THEN 'Mild Fever (37.5-38.4°C)'
        WHEN "Highest Body Temperature (°C)" < 39.5 THEN 'Moderate Fever (38.5-39.4°C)'
        ELSE 'High Fever (≥39.5°C)'
    END AS temperature_range,
    COUNT(*) as case_count,
    ROUND(AVG("Highest Body Temperature (°C)"), 2) as avg_temp
FROM clinical_manifestations
WHERE "Highest Body Temperature (°C)" IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY temperature_range
ORDER BY CASE 
    WHEN temperature_range = 'Normal (<37.5°C)' THEN 1
    WHEN temperature_range = 'Mild Fever (37.5-38.4°C)' THEN 2
    WHEN temperature_range = 'Moderate Fever (38.5-39.4°C)' THEN 3
    ELSE 4
END DESC
'''

for _, row in temp_df.iterrows():
    print(f"\n{row['temperature_range']}:")
    print(f"  Cases: {row['case_count']}")
    print(f"  Average: {row['avg_temp']}°C")
